title: The Lord's Coming Salvation

questions.question: Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy what?
For there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the what?
Shake yourself from the dust and arise; be seated, O Jerusalem; loose the bonds from your neck, O captive daughter of whom?
For thus says the LORD: "You were sold for nothing, and you shall be redeemed without what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:3 (ESV): "and you shall be redeemed without money."

questions.question: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:7 (ESV): "are the feet of him who brings good news,"

questions.question: Who publishes peace, who brings good news of happiness, who publishes salvation, who says to Zion, "Your God what?"
The voice of your watchmen—they lift up their voice; together they sing for joy; for eye to eye they see the return of the LORD to where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:8 (ESV): "the return of the LORD to Zion."

questions.question: Break forth together into singing, you waste places of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted his people; he has redeemed whom?
The LORD has bared his holy arm before the eyes of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:10 (ESV): "shall see the salvation of our God."

questions.question: Depart, depart, go out from there; touch no unclean thing; go out from the midst of her; purify yourselves, you who bear the vessels of the whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:11 (ESV): "you who bear the vessels of the LORD."

questions.question: For you shall not go out in haste, and you shall not go in flight, for the LORD will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:12 (ESV): "and the God of Israel will be your rear guard."

questions.question: Behold, my servant shall act wisely; he shall be high and lifted up, and shall be exalted how much?
As many were astonished at you—his appearance was so marred, beyond human semblance, and his form beyond that of the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:14 (ESV): "beyond that of the children of mankind_"

questions.question: So shall he sprinkle many nations. Kings shall shut their mouths because of him. For that which has not been told them they see, and that which they have not heard they what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:15 (ESV): "and that which they have not heard they understand."

questions.question: At first my people went down to Egypt to sojourn there, and the Assyrian oppressed them for what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 52:4 (ESV): "and the Assyrian oppressed them for nothing."

key_verse_text: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news of happiness, who publishes salvation, who says to Zion, "Your God reigns."
